title: Special Topics in Cell Biology and Molecular Genetics; Visualization for the Life Sciences
description:
Prerequisites: Graduate standing or consent of instructor, and basic familiarity with R, Python, or a similar graphing language.

Methods and software for visualization of scientific data in the life sciences. Tools for bitmapped and vector graphics, 3D rendering, and image analysis. Photographic techniques for research. Videography, animation, and illustration as scientific tools. Clear communication with and universal design in visualization. Counts toward BISI Professional Development Requirement.
